analysis.fit_summary: This Data Engineer Intern role at Cloudflare is ideal for candidates passionate about data engineering and eager to work on impactful projects that enhance data accessibility and insights. Familiarity with ETL processes and data modeling
Knowledge of cloud-based data technologies

resume_tips: Highlight relevant coursework or projects in data engineering
Emphasize any experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP)
Showcase skills in programming languages commonly used in data engineering (e.g., Python, SQL)

Mention any contributions to open-source projects or personal projects involving data
red_flags: Preference for candidates currently enrolled in a relevant degree program
Limited experience in data engineering may be a disadvantage
